title: Carrier Onboarding Authorization Form
subtitle: Carrier Onboarding: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Carrier Onboarding Authorization Form binds carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval to a named transport decision, commercial or operating limit, effective time, and the carrier procurement authority's confirmation. The carrier onboarding coordinator records the requested Carrier Onboarding action and keeps any variance outside the granted authority.
use_case: Use Carrier Onboarding Authorization Form at carrier file, qualification system, dispatch access, and document repository. Reconcile applicable Carrier Onboarding requirements with the load, carrier, rate, claim, equipment, document, or inventory boundary that applies. Capture the carrier procurement authority's approval, counteroffer, hold, or decline, then reauthorize any change to carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval.

sections.guidance: Stop Carrier Onboarding at the stated boundary and obtain renewed consent for a material variance.

blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when carrier identity, authority, insurance, fraud control, or authorized approval remains unresolved. Protect carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval; record the Carrier Onboarding notification and obtain renewed authorization from carrier procurement authority before continuing.
